title: Research: AI dubbing and lip-sync frameworks
objective: Survey open-source AI dubbing and lip-sync frameworks applicable to the AI Media Factory video localisation pipeline. Cover: MuseTalk (Apache 2.0, 30fps real-time, 8GB VRAM), LatentSync 1.5 (Apache 2.0, latent diffusion, 20GB VRAM for training), SadTalker (MIT, talking-head from image). Explicitly flag Wav2Lip as non-commercial (LRS2 training data) and blocked for use. For each allowed tool: quality, license, GPU requirements, production readiness, integration difficulty. Recommend integration sequence. Write results to docs/research/RESEARCH-DUBBING-001.md only.
